title: Wiz reports unauthenticated RCE in Nginx HTTP/2
summary: Wiz has published a report on unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in Nginx&\#x27;s HTTP/2 handling, linking to CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007. The supplied material does not specify affected Nginx versions, the precise exploit conditions, or whether either flaw has been exploited in the wild. It is a vulnerability write-up rather than an Nginx advisory with fixed releases or a remediation timeline.
